# Minimal Landing Page - Design System

**Template**: Minimal Landing Page  
**Direction**: Minimal / Professional  
**Generated by**: OpenCode CoDesign

---

## Visual Direction

**Style**: Minimal / Professional  
**Tone**: Confident, approachable, modern  
**Density**: Balanced with generous whitespace

This design prioritizes clarity and trust. The hero section makes a bold statement while remaining welcoming. Clean typography and strategic use of whitespace guide the eye naturally from headline to action.

---

## Color Palette

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `primary` | `#2563eb` | Primary buttons, accents, icons |
| `primaryDark` | `#1d4ed8` | Button hover states |
| `background` | `#ffffff` | Page background |
| `surface` | `#f8fafc` | Cards, badges, secondary surfaces |
| `text` | `#0f172a` | Primary text, headlines |
| `textMuted` | `#64748b` | Secondary text, descriptions |
| `border` | `#e2e8f0` | Dividers, card borders |

### Color Rationale
- **Blue primary** conveys trust and professionalism
- **High contrast** between text and background ensures readability
- **Muted grays** for secondary content without competing with the main message
- Single accent color keeps focus on CTAs

---

## Typography

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `sans` | Inter, system fallbacks | Body text, UI elements |

### Scale

| Element | Size | Weight |
|---------|------|--------|
| Hero title | `clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem)` | 800 |
| Section heading | `2rem` | 700 |
| Card title | `1.125rem` | 600 |
| Body | `1rem` | 400 |
| Small / Caption | `0.875rem` | 400 |

### Typography Rationale
- **Inter** chosen for its excellent legibility and modern aesthetic
- **Tight letter-spacing** on headlines creates visual impact
- **Size clamp** on hero title ensures good proportions on all devices

---

## Spacing

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `xs` | `0.25rem` | Tight gaps, badge padding |
| `sm` | `0.5rem` | Icon gaps, small padding |
| `md` | `1rem` | Button padding, standard gaps |
| `lg` | `1.5rem` | Card padding, section margins |
| `xl` | `2rem` | Feature margins, nav spacing |
| `2xl` | `3rem` | Section padding, major gaps |
| `3xl` | `4rem` | Hero padding, section separators |

### Spacing Rationale
- Consistent 4px base unit creates visual rhythm
- Generous section padding (`3xl`) lets content breathe
- Tight internal padding keeps components cohesive

---

## Border Radius

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `sm` | `0.25rem` | Small elements |
| `md` | `0.5rem` | Cards, inputs |
| `lg` | `0.75rem` | Buttons, larger cards |
| `xl` | `1rem` | Hero visual container |
| `full` | `9999px` | Badges, avatars |

### Radius Rationale
- Soft corners feel modern and approachable
- Slight variation (`lg` for buttons, `xl` for hero) adds depth hierarchy
- `full` used sparingly for badges to draw attention

---

## Shadows

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `sm` | `0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05)` | Subtle lift |
| `md` | `0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)` | Cards, buttons |
| `lg` | `0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)` | Hero visual, elevated elements |

### Shadow Rationale
- Minimal shadows maintain the clean, minimal aesthetic
- Used primarily to separate interactive elements from background
- Progressive intensity matches visual hierarchy

---

## Component Patterns

### Primary Button
- Background: `primary`
- Text: white, 600 weight
- Padding: `1rem 2rem`
- Radius: `lg`
- Shadow: `md`
- Hover: slight lift, darker background

### Secondary Button
- Background: transparent
- Border: `1px solid border`
- Text: `text`
- Padding: `1rem 2rem`
- Radius: `lg`

### Cards
- Background: `surface`
- Border: `1px solid border`
- Radius: `lg`
- Padding: `xl`

---

## Accessibility Notes

- **Contrast ratios**: All text meets WCAG AA standards
- **Focus states**: Buttons have visible focus rings (browser default enhanced)
- **Semantic HTML**: Proper heading hierarchy (h1 → h2 → h3)
- **Interactive elements**: All buttons are keyboard accessible

---

## Responsive Considerations

- Hero title uses `clamp()` for fluid scaling
- Feature grid uses `auto-fit` for responsive columns
- Container max-width: `72rem` with centered layout
- Mobile padding maintained via container styles

---

## Customization Guide

### Changing Colors
Update the `tokens.colors` object in App.jsx:
```javascript
colors: {
  primary: '#your-color',
  // ... other colors
}
```

### Changing Fonts
Update the `tokens.fonts` object:
```javascript
fonts: {
  sans: 'YourFont, system-ui, sans-serif',
}
```

### Adjusting Spacing
Modify the `tokens.spacing` scale to match your needs.
